description: This file defines a custom annotation interface 'PasswordStrengthCheck' used for validating password strength in user account constraints. It specifies validation parameters and the associated validator class.

classes.name: PasswordStrengthCheck
classes.description: Custom annotation for password strength validation, specifying validation message, groups, payload, and value.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Default validation message prompting users to create stronger passwords.

methods.name: groups
methods.description: Validation groups parameter, default is empty.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Additional data associated with validation message, default is empty.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Specifies the password strength requirement as an enum.
